hypotheses.name: Hashish packets (‘body packing’) presenting as uniform ovoid, moderately dense objects without internal gas or metal
hypotheses.basis: Classic radiographic appearance of hashish-filled condoms or plastic bags: smooth ovoid shape, homogeneous moderate density, no internal gas (unlike some cocaine packets that may show gas from fermentation or packaging), and typical size range (~20–30 mm). hypotheses.name: Cocaine/heroin/methamphetamine packets usually show higher radiodensity or internal heterogeneity
